description: This source file defines the 'Conditional' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, which manages spreadsheet conditional formatting rules. It includes constants for condition and operator types, properties for rule configuration, and methods to set and get these properties.

classes.name: Conditional
classes.description: Represents a conditional formatting rule used in spreadsheets, encapsulating condition types, operators, styles, and related properties for rendering conditional formatting logic.

methods.name: getNoFormatSet
methods.description: Returns whether the noFormat set flag is enabled.

methods.name: setNoFormatSet
methods.description: Sets the noFormat set flag.

methods.name: getConditionType
methods.description: Retrieves the current condition type.

methods.name: setConditionType
methods.description: Sets the condition type, such as 'beginsWith' or 'cellIs'.

methods.name: getOperatorType
methods.description: Retrieves the current operator type.

methods.name: setOperatorType
methods.description: Sets the operator type, such as 'greaterThan' or 'containsText'.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Gets the text value associated with the condition.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text value for the condition.

methods.name: getStopIfTrue
methods.description: Returns whether to stop evaluating further rules if this condition is true.

methods.name: setStopIfTrue
methods.description: Sets whether to stop evaluation on this condition being true.

methods.name: getConditions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of conditions, which could be multiple values.

methods.name: setConditions
methods.description: Sets one or more conditions for this rule.

methods.name: addCondition
methods.description: Adds a single condition to the list of conditions.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Retrieves the style object associated with this conditional rule.

methods.name: setStyle
methods.description: Sets the style object for this rule.

methods.name: getDataBar
methods.description: Retrieves the DataBar, if any, associated with this rule.

methods.name: setDataBar
methods.description: Associates a DataBar with this conditional rule.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code representing the rule's properties for comparison purposes.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Conditional object.

methods.name: isValidConditionType
methods.description: Checks if a given string is a valid condition type.
